components.title: Skill entrypoint
components.description: The AI's role, personality and operating rules. Your package's front door.
components.improve: The entrypoint is built. Tool/platform loading still needs validation in each environment.

components.title: Personal Brand Tech Spec
components.description: Objectives, responsibilities, inputs, instructions, outputs and validation.
components.improve: Living objectives and method; improve through observed use.

components.title: Interviewing guide
components.description: A curious, progressive conversation about the whole person and their ambitions.
components.improve: Create useful work early and deepen progressively.

components.title: Personal Brand KB
components.description: Your identity, positioning, history, interests, beliefs and growing body of knowledge.
components.improve: Identity and positioning progress is shown here; full KB review is a separate milestone.

components.title: Voice & style
components.description: Voice, tone and style that make the words recognizably yours.
components.improve: Review your voice guide and examples. Deferred visuals remain visible.

components.title: Onboarding & progress
components.description: Completion, readiness and active time, with open and deferred work kept visible.
components.improve: Built tracker; readiness and completed-and-reviewed coverage are different.

components.title: Asset template catalog
components.description: Reusable structures for bios, stories, profiles, communications and practical plans.
components.improve: Initial recipes built; quality improves through real outputs.

components.title: Inputs & brand assets
components.description: Original material, accepted profile and bios, plus versioned ideas and working drafts.
components.improve: Build, review and apply starter assets. Keep source materials and earlier versions.

components.title: Presence & relationships
components.description: Where people find you, how you connect, and the actions that bring your brand to life.
components.improve: Review channels, relationship practices and next actions at a feasible pace.

components.title: Maintenance & validation
components.description: Keep the knowledge, assets and next steps accurate as you and your work evolve.
components.improve: Tools built; final KB/readiness/maintenance review remains a separate checklist.

fuel.title: Origin & history studio
fuel.description: Turn pivotal experiences into stories that explain who you are.
fuel.when: You want a richer origin story or material for talks.

fuel.title: Reputation mirror
fuel.description: Compare the impression you intend with the signals people see.
fuel.when: Your public presence may not reflect your current direction.

fuel.title: Voice lab
fuel.description: Experiment with language until the words feel unmistakably yours.
fuel.when: Your drafts feel generic or your voice is evolving.

fuel.title: Trust lab
fuel.description: Make credibility, reliability, connection and care visible in your actions.
fuel.when: You want to strengthen the experience of working with you.

fuel.title: Opportunity compass
fuel.description: Choose opportunities that fit your goals, values and capacity.
fuel.when: You are weighing a role, partnership, invitation or commitment.

fuel.title: Contribution portfolio
fuel.description: Build a credible collection of the impact you have helped create.
fuel.when: You need stronger proof for a profile, talk or opportunity.

fuel.title: Purpose exploration
fuel.description: Explore where your interests, strengths and contribution meet.
fuel.when: You are reconsidering your direction or what matters next.

fuel.title: Audience journey
fuel.description: Make it easier for people to understand how you can help.
fuel.when: People struggle to see where to start or what comes next.

fuel.title: Future lab
fuel.description: Explore a possible future and turn it into a practical experiment.
fuel.when: You want to connect a longer-term ambition to action today.

fuel.title: Relationship experience design
fuel.description: Design thoughtful interactions that help people feel understood.
fuel.when: You want meetings, follow-ups or gatherings to offer more value.

fuel.title: Audience field test
fuel.description: Test a message or asset with people you want to serve.
fuel.when: You want evidence that your positioning or content actually connects.
